comments.why: Related to idea that the universe is fields of numbers
comments.text: Quantum Field Theory visualized [VIDEO] Here's a more general idea. Our modern physics says that the whole universe is filled with fields and field is composed of numbers. What if we take that literally? When we say an electron is present here, we actually mean that there are more copies of particular number superposed at that place.
